name: Medium Earth Orbit
story: The navigation band — roughly 20,000 km up, where a constellation of 24+ satellites can paint every point on Earth with at least four simultaneously-visible spacecraft (the minimum for a 3D fix). All four major global positioning systems live here, intentionally spread across four independent regimes by their operating agencies. Above the inner Van Allen belt, below the outer one — a calm, high orbit.
comparison: About 1/19th of the way to the Moon. A signal from GPS takes ~67 ms to reach your phone — about 10× the LEO bounce.

firsts.label: GLONASS Block I — first Soviet GNSS satellite
